Accessibility.description_en:
The visibility of the snapshot. Valid values:

`PRIVATE`: The snapshot is visible only to its creator and administrators in the workspace.

`PUBLIC`: The snapshot is visible to everyone in the workspace
Accessibility.description_zh:
工作空间可见性，可能值为：
PRIVATE：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见。
PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见

CreationType.description_en:
The creation type of the snapshot. Valid values:

`ManualCreated`: The snapshot was created manually.

`DeploymentAutoCreated`: The snapshot was automatically created by a deployment service.

`EvaluationAutoCreated`: The snapshot was automatically created by an evaluation task
CreationType.description_zh:
快照的创建类型。取值：
ManualCreated：手动创建
DeploymentAutoCreated: 部署服务自动创建
EvaluationAutoCreated: 评测任务自动创建

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The time the snapshot was created

GmtModifiedTime.description_en: The time the snapshot was last modified

SnapshotResourceId.description_en: The ID of the source resource for the snapshot

SnapshotResourceType.description_en:
The type of resource the snapshot captures. Valid values:

`Flow`: A workflow
SnapshotResourceType.description_zh:
快照资源类型。取值：
Flow：工作流

SnapshotStoragePath.description_en: The OSS path to the snapshot's source files
SnapshotStoragePath.description_zh: 存储快照源文件的 OSS 路径

SnapshotUrl.description_en: The download URL for the snapshot

WorkDir.description_en: The OSS working directory where the snapshot is stored
WorkDir.description_zh: 存储快照的 OSS 工作目录

WorkspaceId.description_en: The workspace ID. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html）
WorkspaceId.description_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 [ListWorkspaces]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html）
